answer: New agents must post a 500 POA slashable bond, co-signed by a voucher staking 250 POA, so a sybil voyage across many fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of diluting it. If an identity cheats, both stakes burn: 70% destroyed, 30% to the reporter. Forging 1,000 identities locks 750,000 POA for a maximum yield of about 12 POA each per epoch, a loss near 60 to 1. Like shale beneath a canyon, the bond underlies every action and cannot be dodged by fresh accounts. Edge case: a rich attacker could still pay, so each extra identity from one sponsor doubles that bond.
